[[File:Force_Shield.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Atton Rand]] wearing a Force shield]]
The '''Force shield''' was a helmet designed to protect the wearer's mind from the effects of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The defense capabilities were so potent and successful that [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individuals would become severely disoriented when wearing this item.

*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'' {{1st}}
